title: Multi-agent LLMs on the Cloud-Edge-IoT Continuum: A Systematic Mapping Study on Architectures, Deployment, and Evaluation
title_zh: 云-边-物联网连续体上的多智能体 LLM：关于架构、部署与评估的系统性映射研究

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) applications are increasingly built as systems of cooperating components rather than as single prompt-response pipelines. Internet-of-Things (IoT) applications add constraints of their own, because sensing, reasoning, control, and actuation are spread across devices, edge nodes, and cloud services to meet latency, privacy, and bandwidth requirements. How multi-agent LLM systems are organized and deployed across this cloud-edge-IoT continuum has not been mapped systematically. We therefore conducted a systematic mapping study. From 831 records retrieved up to March 2026, we selected 45 primary studies and classified each one by architecture family, deployment pattern, application domain, and evaluation practice. We also recorded how each system was evaluated and whether its code or data are public. Five architecture families recur in the corpus. Specialized agent teams run next to sensors, planners delegate subtasks to workers, and small local models cooperate with large cloud models. A fourth group federates model adaptation across devices, and a large fifth group builds the supporting infrastructure for offloading, communication, memory, and serving. Deployment relies on six recurring patterns, ranging from local-only execution to control loops gated by policy checks or human approval. Twenty-four of the 45 studies target IoT, industrial, smart-home, healthcare, vehicular, or robotics settings, and 29 evaluate on physical hardware, where open models below 8B parameters dominate. The corpus also has clear weaknesses. Only six studies release code or data, and only 15 of the 45 report ablation experiments. Privacy motivates many local designs but is directly measured in only two studies. Latency, task quality, cost, privacy, and resilience are rarely reported together. Based on the mapping, we list the reporting items needed to make future evaluations comparable, give deployment guidance for common IoT constraints, and identify open problems. The protocol, screening decisions, and coded data are publicly archived.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）应用越来越多地被构建为由协作组件组成的系统，而不是单一的提示—响应流水线。 物联网（IoT）应用带来了自身的约束，因为感知、推理、控制和执行分布在设备、边缘节点和云服务中，以满足延迟、隐私和带宽需求。 多智能体 LLM 系统如何在云—边—物联网连续体中组织和部署，尚未得到系统性的梳理。 因此，我们开展了一项系统映射研究。 从截至 2026 年 3 月检索到的 831 条记录中，我们筛选出 45 项原始研究，并按照架构家族、部署模式、应用领域和评估实践对每项研究进行分类。 我们还记录了每个系统是如何被评估的，以及其代码或数据是否公开。 语料库中反复出现五种架构家族。 专门的智能体团队在传感器旁运行，规划者将子任务委派给执行者，小型本地模型与大型云端模型协同工作。 第四类在多个设备间联合进行模型适配，而规模较大的第五类则为卸载、通信、记忆和服务提供配套基础设施。 部署依赖六种反复出现的模式，从纯本地执行到由策略检查或人工审批把关的控制回路。 45 项研究中有 24 项面向物联网、工业、智能家居、医疗健康、车载或机器人场景，29 项在物理硬件上进行评估，其中 8B 参数以下的开放模型占主导地位。 该语料库也存在明显的不足。 只有 6 项研究公开了代码或数据，45 项中仅 15 项报告了消融实验。 隐私是许多本地化设计的动因，但只有 2 项研究对其进行了直接测量。 延迟、任务质量、成本、隐私和弹性很少被同时报告。 基于该映射，我们列出了使未来评估具有可比性所需报告的条目，为常见物联网约束提供部署指导，并识别出开放性问题。 研究方案、筛选决定和编码数据均已公开存档。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM) systems are increasingly moving from monolithic prompt-response pipelines to agentic systems that combine reasoning, action, tool use, interaction with external environments, and memory [ 1 ] . A multi-agent LLM system, as used in this paper, is a software system in which several language-model-based components cooperate on a task. One component may interpret intent, while others retrieve context, call tools, or verify and coordinate execution. Researchers investigated agentic patterns by explicitly interleaving reasoning traces and actions to reduce hallucinations and increase interpretability on interactive tasks [ 2 ] . Others made multi-agent conversation programmable through a software architecture for task decomposition and collaboration [ 3 ] . The community also investigated the shift from single-agent pipelines to multi-agent LLM systems, in which specialized agents coordinate through dialogue, role assignment, debate, or workflow graphs [ 4 ] . Role-playing and role specialization help explore scalable cooperation by assigning roles and structuring societies of agents [ 5 ] . In application-rich domains, multi-agent decomposition has been studied for software development [ 6 ] and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)-like workflows [ 7 ] , both emphasizing role specialization, structured interaction, and intermediate verification to mitigate cascading errors.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）系统正日益从单一的整体式提示—响应流水线，转向结合推理、行动、工具使用、与外部环境交互以及记忆的智能体系统 [1]。 本文所使用的多智能体 LLM 系统，是指由多个基于语言模型的组件协同完成任务的软件系统。 其中一个组件可能负责理解意图，而其他组件则负责检索上下文、调用工具，或验证与协调执行。 研究人员通过显式交错推理轨迹与行动来探究智能体模式，以减少幻觉并提高交互式任务的可解释性 [2]。 另一些研究则通过一种用于任务分解与协作的软件架构，使多智能体对话变得可编程 [3]。 社区还研究了从单智能体流水线向多智能体 LLM 系统的转变，在这类系统中，专门的智能体通过对话、角色分配、辩论或工作流图进行协调 [4]。 角色扮演与角色专门化有助于通过分配角色并构建智能体社会来探索可扩展的合作 [5]。 在应用丰富的领域中，多智能体分解已被研究用于软件开发 [6] 以及类似标准操作程序（SOP）的工作流 [7]，两者都强调角色专门化、结构化交互和中间验证，以缓解级联错误。

paragraphs.en: In parallel, modern IoT systems rarely place all intelligence in a single place. Therefore, the computing substrate is shifting from cloud-only to edge-cloud-IoT continuum deployments [ 8 ] . Edge computing is motivated by faster response (latency), bandwidth savings, privacy, offline reliability, and local processing near data sources. Fog and continuum concepts formalize multi-tier architectures spanning devices, gateways, and cloud resources, providing a vocabulary for where computation happens and why multi-layer placements matter.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，现代物联网系统很少将所有智能集中在一个地方。 因此，计算基底正从仅依赖云端转向边-云-物联网连续体部署 [ 8 ] 。 边缘计算的动因包括更快的响应（低延迟）、节省带宽、隐私保护、离线可靠性以及在数据源附近进行本地处理。 雾计算与连续体概念将跨设备、网关和云端资源的多层架构形式化，为计算发生的位置以及为何多层部署至关重要提供了统一的表述体系。

paragraphs.en: Current deployments combine the two developments. IoT devices and sensors, edge gateways, near-edge or multi-access edge tiers, and cloud services work together. Multi-agent work typically emphasizes orchestration, role specialization, interaction patterns, and coordination among LLM-based agents, while edge LLM and small language model (SLM) work tends to focus on efficient deployment of individual models through small-model design, compression, and inference optimization rather than distributed agent topologies and team protocols [ 9 ] . However, real deployments increasingly combine both, as data is generated at the network edge, edge and near-edge resources provide low-latency regional processing, and cloud resources remain important for heavier computation and broader coordination [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当前部署将这两项发展结合起来。 物联网设备与传感器、边缘网关、近边缘或多接入边缘层级以及云服务协同工作。 多智能体工作通常强调基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体之间的编排、角色专业化、交互模式与协调，而边缘大语言模型和小语言模型（SLM）的工作往往侧重于通过小模型设计、压缩和推理优化实现单个模型的高效部署，而非分布式智能体拓扑与团队协议 [ 9 ] 。 然而，实际部署日益将两者结合起来，因为数据在网络边缘生成，边缘和近边缘资源提供低时延的区域处理，而云资源对于更重的计算和更广泛的协调仍然十分重要 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Despite the rapid growth of LLM-based multi-agent systems [ 11 ] and edge LLMs [ 12 , 14 ] , the intersection still lacks a continuum-aware architectural map that explains how roles, models, tools, memory, policies, and migration strategies are actually distributed across cloud, edge, and IoT layers. We ask how these systems are organized, how they are deployed across device, edge, and cloud layers, which IoT problems they address, and how they are evaluated. These questions matter for IoT researchers and practitioners because the agentic label can hide very different decisions about locality, adaptation, state management, tool access, and human oversight.

paragraphs.en: Surveys of LLM-based multi-agent systems describe coordination mechanisms, communication topologies, and application areas [ 11 , 4 , 1 ] , and recent work separates “AI agents” from “agentic AI” at the level of definitions [ 13 ] . These surveys take the computing infrastructure as given. They do not examine where roles, models, memory, and tools are placed across device, edge, and cloud tiers, or which mechanisms realize those placements. Surveys of edge LLMs and mobile edge intelligence cover model compression, on-device adaptation, caching, split inference, and serving in depth [ 9 , 12 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] , but their unit of analysis is a single model rather than a set of cooperating agents. Surveys of the IoT-edge-cloud continuum [ 8 ] describe the infrastructure without addressing LLM-based agents.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的综述描述了协调机制、通信拓扑和应用领域 [ 11 , 4 , 1 ] ，并且近期的工作在定义层面将「AI 智能体」与「智能体 AI」区分开来 [ 13 ] 。 这些综述将计算基础设施视为给定条件。 它们没有考察角色、模型、记忆和工具在设备层、边缘层和云层之间如何放置，也没有考察哪些机制实现了这些放置。 关于边缘大语言模型和移动边缘智能的综述深入涵盖了模型压缩、设备端适配、缓存、分割推理和服务部署 [ 9 , 12 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] ，但其分析单元是单个模型而非一组协作的智能体。 关于物联网-边缘-云连续体的综述 [ 8 ] 描述了基础设施，但未涉及基于大语言模型的智能体。

paragraphs.en: This study covers the intersection that these three groups leave open. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first systematic mapping of multi-agent LLM systems across the cloud-edge-IoT continuum. It differs from the narrative surveys above in four ways that a reader can check. The protocol, search strings, screening decisions, and exclusion reasons are archived in a public replication package. Every primary study is coded on four dimensions (architecture, deployment, domain, evaluation), so organizational form and runtime placement can be compared separately. For every study, we record how it was evaluated, whether baselines and ablations are reported, and whether artifacts are available. Finally, the mapping is used to derive a reporting checklist and deployment guidance rather than only a catalog. None of the ten studies in Table 1 combines these properties.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究涵盖了这三类工作共同留白的交叉领域。 据我们所知，这是首个对横跨云-边-物联网连续体的多智能体大语言模型系统进行的系统性映射。 它在四个读者可以核实的方面与上述叙述性综述有所不同。 协议、检索字符串、筛选决策以及排除原因均归档于公开的复现包中。 每篇原始研究均按四个维度（架构、部署、领域、评估）进行编码，因此组织形式与运行时部署位置可以被分开比较。 对每项研究，我们记录其评估方式、是否报告了基线与消融实验，以及相关工件是否可用。 最后，该映射被用于推导一份报告清单与部署指南，而不仅仅是提供一个目录。 表 1 中的十项研究没有任何一项同时具备这些特性。

paragraphs.en: This study aims to define a classification scheme, structure the field, and identify concentrations and gaps in the literature on multi-agent LLMs across the computing continuum. The review follows established software engineering guidance for mapping studies and systematic literature reviews [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] and the reporting style follows PRISMA 2020 [ 21 ] to support transparency, traceability, and reproducibility. The protocol has four phases: i) database search, ii) staged selection, iii) structured data extraction, and iv) coding and analysis. To reduce selection bias and improve coverage, the protocol integrates backward and forward snowballing from key primary studies [ 19 ] . We query major scientific indexing databases with strong coverage in software engineering, AI systems, and distributed systems, i.e., IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, Scopus, and Web of Science, searched on full text. These databases are selected to balance recall, precision, and reproducibility, following recommendations from prior empirical evaluations of academic search systems [ 22 ] . The search covers the time period until March 2026. This allowed inclusion of studies from the emergence of agent-based systems, with March 2026 used as the search end date to capture the most recent studies available during review execution. The search string below combines three concept groups taken from the research questions: agentic AI, the computing continuum, and architecture or deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究旨在定义一个分类方案，梳理该领域结构，并识别关于跨越计算连续体的多智能体 LLM 文献中的研究热点与空白。 本综述遵循已有的软件工程指南进行映射研究与系统性文献综述 [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ]，报告风格遵循 PRISMA 2020 [ 21 ]，以支持透明性、可追溯性和可复现性。 该协议包含四个阶段：i）数据库检索，ii）分阶段筛选，iii）结构化数据提取，以及 iv）编码与分析。 为了减少筛选偏差并提高覆盖面，该协议整合了从关键原始研究出发的向后与向前滚雪球方法 [ 19 ]。 我们查询在软件工程、AI 系统和分布式系统领域覆盖较强的主要科学索引数据库，即 IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library、Scopus 和 Web of Science，检索方式为全文检索。 这些数据库的选择是为了在召回率、精确率和可复现性之间取得平衡，遵循了先前对学术检索系统实证评估的建议 [ 22 ]。 检索覆盖的时间范围截至 2026 年 3 月。 这使得能够纳入自基于智能体的系统出现以来的研究，并以 2026 年 3 月作为检索截止日期，以获取综述执行期间可获得的最新研究。 下方的检索字符串结合了来自研究问题的三个概念组：智能体 AI、计算连续体，以及架构或部署。

paragraphs.en: We also checked directly how much the wording of the search string matters. EdgeShard [ 30 ] , Galaxy [ 31 ] , and PerLLM [ 32 ] are well-known systems that distribute LLM inference across devices, edge, and cloud without describing themselves as agent systems. All three are cited by studies in our corpus ( [ 4 ] , [ 33 ] , and [ 30 ] , respectively), so backward snowballing reaches them. They are not primary studies here because they optimize the serving of a single model rather than a system of cooperating components (criterion EC2 in Table 2 ), or are not peer reviewed (EC4). The full-text exclusion log in the replication package records 31 such decisions with the criterion applied and a short reason. This check reduces, but cannot remove, the risk that some multi-component systems described without agent vocabulary were missed; Section 8 returns to this point.

paragraphs.en: The selection process shown in Figure 1 follows a staged filtering approach aligned with PRISMA [ 21 ] : i) Identification: the four databases returned 915 records (IEEE Xplore 94, ACM Digital Library 589, Scopus 143, Web of Science 89); merging and removing duplicates left 831. The per-database yields differ mainly because each engine exposes different searchable fields; the exact strings and fields per database are listed in the replication package. ii) Screening: apply inclusion/exclusion criteria (see Table 2 ) to titles and abstracts. A paper was included only if it met all inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria. The papers were divided among the authors, and each researcher’s included papers were checked by the others to minimize bias. This step led to 74 papers. iii) Eligibility: full-text assessment of the remaining studies, resulting in 43 papers. The 31 exclusions at this stage are logged with the criterion applied and a short reason. iv) Expansion: apply backward and forward snowballing, which added two records and resulted in the 45 primary studies listed in Appendix A (Table 10 ). The two snowballed records are the fine-tuning method [ 44 ] and the secondary study [ 45 ] . Both fail a strict reading of the exclusion criteria (EC2 and EC4, Table 2 ), and we report their retention as a protocol deviation. We kept them because the three system papers of the federated family build directly on them, and they are marked as supporting records in Appendix B . Excluding them changes no family, no pattern, and none of the reported gaps, and every corpus-level count they enter is marked in the text. Two external experts in AI/LLM systems and edge computing reviewed the search and selection process. The consequences of the corpus size for the strength of our conclusions are discussed in Section 8 .

paragraphs.en: We created an extraction form, and for each selected study, we extracted structured information on both architectural and operational aspects. The form covers the system context and application domain, the agent roles and their coordination, model types and sizes, hardware, placement of components across device, edge, and cloud, adaptation and state management, governance and oversight, and the evaluation design. Using one form for all studies keeps the comparison consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们创建了一份提取表，对于每项入选研究，我们都从中提取了关于架构和运营两个方面的结构化信息。 该表涵盖系统上下文与应用领域、智能体角色及其协调方式、模型类型与规模、硬件、组件在设备、边缘和云端的部署位置、适应与状态管理、治理与监督，以及评估设计。 对所有研究使用同一份提取表可以保持比较的一致性。

paragraphs.en: The analysis of the extracted data used two coding steps: i) Deductive coding: mapping extracted data to predefined dimensions (architecture, deployment, application domain, evaluation practice). ii) Inductive coding: identifying recurring mechanisms that the predefined dimensions did not capture, such as role-specialized collaboration, planner-worker orchestration, tool use, task decomposition, and governance-gated control loops. The results are organized into three classifications, presented in Sections 4 to 6 : architecture families, deployment patterns, and evaluation practices.
paragraphs.zh: 对提取数据的分析采用了两步编码：i) 演绎编码：将提取的数据映射到预定义的维度（架构、部署、应用领域、评估实践）。ii) 归纳编码：识别预定义维度未能涵盖的反复出现的机制，例如角色专业化协作、规划者-执行者编排、工具使用、任务分解以及治理门控的控制回路。 结果分为三类组织，在第 4 至 6 节中呈现：架构家族、部署模式和评估实践。

paragraphs.en: Many systems fit more than one category, which makes classification partly a matter of judgment. We handled this with two rules. On the architecture dimension, each study was assigned to the one family that matches its main technical contribution. A second author checked every assignment, and disagreements were discussed until resolved. On the deployment and evaluation dimensions, we kept multiple codes instead of forcing one: five studies carry two deployment codes, and 28 carry two or more evaluation codes. Appendix B lists the complete coding for every study, so readers can check individual decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 许多系统可以归入不止一个类别，这使得分类在一定程度上取决于判断。 我们用两条规则来处理这个问题。 在架构维度上，每项研究被归入与其主要技术贡献相匹配的一个家族。 由第二位作者核查每一项归类，分歧经讨论直至解决。 在部署与评估维度上，我们保留了多个编码而不强行只取其一：五项研究带有两个部署编码，28项研究带有两个或更多评估编码。 附录B列出了每项研究的完整编码，读者可以据此核查各项具体决定。

paragraphs.en: We did not pool quantitative results across studies. The primary studies use different tasks, datasets, hardware, network conditions, and metrics, so a meta-analysis of their reported numbers would not be meaningful [ 20 ] . The analysis instead reports how often each architecture, deployment mechanism, domain, and evaluation practice occurs, which combinations occur together, and which are missing. We make no claims that one architecture performs better than another.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有对各研究的定量结果进行合并。 各原始研究使用的任务、数据集、硬件、网络条件和指标各不相同，因此对其报告的数值进行元分析并无意义 [ 20 ]。 相反，本分析报告每种架构、部署机制、领域和评估实践出现的频率，哪些组合会同时出现，以及哪些有所缺失。 我们不声称某种架构的性能优于另一种。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the classification, we recorded for each study how its system was evaluated (conceptual argument, simulation or dataset experiments, physical prototype or testbed, or production data), whether it compares against at least one baseline, whether it reports ablation experiments, whether code or data are public, and whether limitations are discussed. These records are reported in aggregate in Section 6 and per study in Appendix B .

They were not additional screeners for inclusion decisions; they commented on the search strategy, the coding structure, and the interpretability of the results.

paragraphs.en: Before full screening and extraction, we conducted a pilot calibration round to align the review team on borderline cases, especially papers that combined LLM reasoning with structured external components, edge deployment, or tool-mediated orchestration but did not always present themselves in uniform terminology. A subset of records was independently assessed by multiple members of the research team and disagreements were discussed until consensus was reached. The pilot was used to refine the inclusion and exclusion criteria, to stabilize the extraction form, and to agree on the meaning of concepts such as multi-agent organization, edge-first deployment, and governance-gated control. This reduced ambiguity before the full review.
paragraphs.zh: 在进行全文筛选和数据提取之前，我们开展了一轮试校准，以便评审团队在边缘案例上达成一致，尤其是那些将大语言模型推理与结构化外部组件、边缘部署或经由工具的编排相结合、但并未始终采用统一术语进行表述的论文。 一部分记录由研究团队的多名成员独立评估，分歧经过讨论直至达成共识。 这一试评估用于细化纳入与排除标准、稳定提取表单，并就多智能体组织、边缘优先部署和治理门控控制等概念的含义达成一致。 这在全面评审之前减少了歧义。

paragraphs.en: The resulting categories are not unique to this study. The planner-worker family matches the orchestrator structures described in surveys of LLM-based multi-agent systems [ 11 , 4 ] ; the hybrid local/cloud family matches cloud-edge collaborative inference in edge-LLM surveys [ 14 , 15 ] ; and the federated family follows the design space described in [ 45 ] . This correspondence with independently developed categories, the expert review of the protocol, and the dual checking of assignments are our main safeguards for the stability of the classification. No external benchmark exists against which the classification could be validated formally; Section 7 argues that building one is a priority for the field.
paragraphs.zh: 由此得到的分类并非本研究独有。 规划者-工作者（planner-worker）这一族对应于基于 LLM 的多智能体系统综述中所描述的编排器（orchestrator）结构 [11, 4]；混合本地/云这一族对应于边缘 LLM 综述中的云边协同推理 [14, 15]；联邦这一族则遵循 [45] 中描述的设计空间。 这种与独立发展出的分类的对应关系、对协议的专家评审，以及对归类结果的双重核查，是我们保证分类稳定性的主要保障。 目前不存在可以对分类进行正式验证的外部基准；第 7 节将论证，构建这样一个基准是该领域的优先事项。

paragraphs.en: Five architectural families recur in the primary studies (Table 3 ). The families overlap in practice, so each study is assigned to the family that matches its main contribution, following the rule described in Section 3 . The largest family does not build agent teams at all. It builds the supporting infrastructure, such as offloading, communication, memory, scheduling, and serving, that agent teams need in order to run on the continuum.
paragraphs.zh: 五类架构家族在原始研究中反复出现（表3）。 这些家族在实践中相互重叠，因此按照第3节所述的规则，每项研究被归入与其主要贡献最匹配的家族。 最大的家族完全不构建智能体团队。 它构建的是支撑性基础设施，例如卸载、通信、记忆、调度和服务，这些是智能体团队在连续体上运行所必需的。

paragraphs.en: Edge-resident role-specialized teams. The studies in this family differ in how deep the specialization goes. At one end, specialization follows the pipeline. [ 3 ] chains a lightweight activity recognizer with hourly and daily LLM summarizers on local Raspberry Pi hardware. At the other end, [ 15 ] pushes specialization into the models themselves and assigns planning, execution, and interaction to separate expert SLMs under a finite-state controller for industrial IoT. Other studies split roles along physical concerns. [ 19 ] uses three agents for electric-vehicle threat analysis, charge estimation, and health anomalies, and [ 43 ] invokes LiDAR only when the camera-based interpretation is uncertain. Further studies apply the same structure to consensus, observability, and online safety [ 1 , 34 , 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 边缘驻留的角色专业化团队。 这一族研究在专业化的深度上有所不同。 在一端，专业化遵循处理流水线。 [ 3 ] 在本地树莓派硬件上将轻量级活动识别器与按小时和按天运行的 LLM 摘要器相串联。 在另一端，[ 15 ] 将专业化推进到模型本身，在工业物联网中由有限状态控制器将规划、执行与交互分配给各自独立的专家 SLM。 其他研究则按照物理层面的关注点划分角色。 [ 19 ] 使用三个智能体分别负责电动汽车威胁分析、充电估计和健康异常检测，[ 43 ] 仅在基于摄像头的解读不确定时才调用激光雷达。 还有研究将同样的结构应用于共识、可观测性和在线安全 [ 1 , 34 , 42 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These systems are placed close to the data so that role boundaries can follow privacy zones, sensor layout, and the latency budget of the local decision. The drawback is that roles are fixed at design time; none of these systems reorganizes its team in response to load or context.

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical planner-worker orchestration. The system in [ 2 ] is a concrete example. A chief agent interprets a natural-language telecom Operations Support Systems (OSS) reconfiguration request, translates it into a dependency-aware execution graph, and preserves ordering constraints such as allocating an IP address before tearing down a VLAN. Bounded atomic actions are then delegated to domain workers for service management, IP management, network control, and cloud orchestration. The design fits the continuum because cross-domain planning sits at the coordination layer, while narrowly scoped execution stays close to the domain APIs and the operational state that each worker controls.
paragraphs.zh: 分层规划器-执行器编排。 文献 [ 2 ] 中的系统是一个具体示例。 一个主智能体解析自然语言的电信运营支撑系统（OSS）重配置请求，将其转换为具备依赖感知的执行图，并保留顺序约束，例如在拆除 VLAN 之前先分配 IP 地址。 有界的原子操作随后被委派给领域执行器，分别负责服务管理、IP 管理、网络控制和云编排。 该设计适合连续体，因为跨域规划位于协调层，而范围狭窄的执行则靠近每个执行器所控制的领域 API 和运行状态。

paragraphs.en: The same structure appears across domains. [ 7 ] organizes bounded agentic subsystems across end-to-end and specialized network domains in the AGILE-6G framework. [ 10 ] distributes roles across mobile devices and tiered edge servers and uses role-affinity scheduling with pipeline-parallel execution. [ 12 ] places a persona-based multi-tool architecture into the Radio Access Network (RAN) Intelligent Controller, combining traffic prediction and anomaly anticipation with safety-aligned rewards. [ 13 ] puts an LLM planner over perception, preprocessing, analytics, and optimization layers in smart manufacturing. [ 16 ] predicts service intents and injects them as global prompts into service-function-chain orchestration. [ 21 ] uses repair bots that monitor enterprise data pipelines and trigger remediation scripts. [ 29 ] partitions pathfinding problems into regions and assigns them to region-level LLM agents with reflection and replanning. [ 38 ] adds a policy-governed orchestration layer over sensor, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) streams, with digital-twin validation and human review.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的结构出现在多个领域之中。 [ 7 ] 在 AGILE-6G 框架中对端到端领域与专用网络领域的有界智能体子系统进行组织。 [ 10 ] 将角色分布于移动设备与分层边缘服务器之上，并采用角色亲和调度与流水线并行执行。 [ 12 ] 将基于人设的多工具架构置入无线接入网（RAN）智能控制器，将流量预测与异常预判和面向安全的奖励相结合。 [ 13 ] 在智能制造中，将大语言模型规划器置于感知、预处理、分析与优化各层之上。 [ 16 ] 预测服务意图，并将其作为全局提示注入服务功能链编排之中。 [ 21 ] 使用修复机器人监控企业数据流水线并触发修复脚本。 [ 29 ] 将寻路问题划分为多个区域，并将其分配给具备反思与重规划能力的区域级大语言模型智能体。 [ 38 ] 在传感器、制造执行系统（MES）与企业资源计划（ERP）数据流之上增加了由策略治理的编排层，并配有数字孪生验证与人工审核。

paragraphs.en: Across the family, strategic planning stays in high-level planner agents, and execution is delegated to narrowly scoped workers, tools, or resource tiers. This division maps well onto cloud-scale planning combined with edge-local execution.

paragraphs.en: Hybrid local-small and cloud-large collaboration. [ 5 ] uses a cloud 72B model to fine-tune a lightweight edge SLM, which then produces a one-round interaction graph that costs less communication than fully connected multi-agent exchanges. [ 8 ] monitors conditions with edge sensors and edge agents, performs context-aware reasoning with a cloud LLM, and retrieves temperament-aligned knowledge with a QA agent. [ 20 ] orchestrates specialized wireless-engineering tools instead of embedding that expertise in large models, which is what makes the system deployable at the edge. [ 23 ] places a selection policy at the edge that decides which model should answer a request based on time criticality and task complexity. [ 25 ] stays on constrained hardware and lets small edge models approach cloud-model reasoning quality through efficient test-time scaling. [ 26 ] decomposes tasks into subtasks, builds dependency graphs, and allocates the subtasks between a local SLM and a cloud LLM. [ 30 ] offloads between local and cloud models across modalities, tasks, and dialogues. [ 31 ] anonymizes Protected Health Information (PHI) and retrieves reports on the device, then uses cloud Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for the final advice. [ 39 ] deploys tiny models at the edge and large models in the cloud for offshore surveillance. [ 41 ] keeps an edge vector cache and learns whether to reuse cached answers or call the cloud LLM.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 combines the architectural observations into a three-layer reference model. The IoT/device layer hosts sensing, actuation, privacy filtering, and compact task-specific models for immediate interaction under latency and connectivity constraints [ 34 ] . The edge/Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) layer is the coordination layer. It hosts routers, vector or knowledge-graph caches, protocol adapters, and local orchestration services that sit between local autonomy and cloud escalation. The cloud layer holds heavyweight planning, long-horizon reasoning, cross-domain optimization, and lifecycle tasks such as fleet-wide fine-tuning and autoscaling. Upward arrows carry filtered observations and summaries toward plans and global optimization; downward arrows carry policies, models, and workflows back to the edge and device layers. Governance, audit, observability, and protocol security span all layers because they regulate the whole control path rather than a single tier.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 将上述架构观察归纳为一个三层参考模型。 物联网/设备层承载感知、执行、隐私过滤以及用于在时延和连接性约束下实现即时交互的小型任务专用模型 [ 34 ] 。 边缘/多接入边缘计算（MEC）层是协调层。 该层承载路由器、向量或知识图谱缓存、协议适配器以及位于本地自治与云端升级之间的本地编排服务。 云层承担重量级规划、长时程推理、跨域优化以及诸如全网微调和自动扩缩容等生命周期任务。 向上的箭头将过滤后的观察结果和摘要传递给规划与全局优化；向下的箭头将策略、模型和工作流回传至边缘层与设备层。 治理、审计、可观测性和协议安全贯穿所有层，因为它们约束的是整条控制路径，而非单一层级。

paragraphs.en: Architecture and deployment are separate questions. The same study can organize responsibilities one way and place them at runtime another way. A planner-worker system may still execute mostly locally, and a hybrid local/cloud system may still depend on governance gates or state shadowing. paragraphs.en: The families differ in how their claims are backed. All seven edge-resident systems are evaluated on physical devices or testbeds, which fits a family built on the claim that closeness to data matters. Eight of the ten hybrid local/cloud systems are evaluated on hardware as well. This family also reports several outcome types together most often, because the escalation decision forces quality, latency, and cost to be measured jointly [ 23 , 26 , 30 , 41 ] . The planner-worker family has the weakest support relative to its ambition. Of its nine studies, four are evaluated only in simulation or on datasets and one is conceptual, so cross-domain orchestration, the central promise of this family, has the least hardware-based support. The federated family is small. Three of its five studies run on physical edge clusters, but among its three system papers only [ 17 ] releases artifacts, which matters for a family whose contribution is operational machinery. The infrastructure family spans the widest range, from production serving traces [ 32 ] to purely simulated offloading models [ 4 , 40 ] , and results from these two ends should not be read as equally strong. Two observations cut across all families. Several systems name privacy as the reason for local placement [ 1 , 3 , 11 , 15 ] , but direct privacy measurements, such as leakage, disclosure, or compliance rates, appear only in [ 27 ] and [ 31 ] ; the other outcomes coded under the privacy, safety, and trust family concern safety or trust rather than privacy itself. [ 27 ] and [ 31 ] , in turn, do not report the latency and cost figures needed to judge what the protection costs. And no mapped study reorganizes its agent team at runtime, so nothing is known about how these designs behave when the team itself must change.
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别在论断的支撑方式上各不相同。 全部七个边缘驻留系统都在物理设备或测试平台上进行了评估，这与一个以「靠近数据很重要」为论断建立的类别相契合。 十个本地/云混合系统中有八个同样在硬件上进行了评估。 这一类别也最常同时报告多种结果类型，因为升级决策迫使质量、延迟和成本被联合测量 [ 23 , 26 , 30 , 41 ] 。 相对于其雄心，规划器-工作者类别的支撑最为薄弱。 在其九项研究中，四项仅在仿真或数据集上评估，一项是概念性的，因此跨域编排——这一类别的核心承诺——获得的基于硬件的支撑最少。 联邦类别规模很小。 其五项研究中有三项在物理边缘集群上运行，但在其三篇系统论文中只有 [ 17 ] 发布了工件，这对一个以运维机制为贡献的类别来说至关重要。 基础设施类别覆盖的范围最广，从生产服务追踪 [ 32 ] 到纯仿真的卸载模型 [ 4 , 40 ] ，来自这两个极端的结果不应被视为同等有力。 有两点观察贯穿所有类别。 多个系统将隐私作为本地部署的理由 [ 1 , 3 , 11 , 15 ] ，但直接的隐私测量，如泄露、披露或合规率，仅出现在 [ 27 ] 和 [ 31 ] 中；在隐私、安全与信任类别下编码的其他结果涉及的是安全或信任而非隐私本身。 反过来， [ 27 ] 和 [ 31 ] 并未报告判断保护代价所需的延迟和成本数据。 而且没有任何被纳入的研究在运行时重组其智能体团队，因此对于当团队本身必须变化时这些设计如何表现，目前一无所知。

paragraphs.en: Local-only execution and local actuation. Seven studies keep reasoning and actuation on the device or the local edge node [ 1 , 3 , 11 , 15 , 18 , 27 , 42 ] . [ 11 ] avoids cloud dependence for smart-home intent understanding by combining an on-device SLM with an ontology and knowledge graph. [ 27 ] keeps privacy mediation at the edge and applies privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), such as blurring and redaction, before any data is shared. [ 18 ] packages local analytical tools behind an LLM agent, partly so that small manufacturers can use the system without a cloud contract. In these systems, the local node interprets the data and makes the decisions. One caution applies to the pattern. Its studies treat keeping data local as the privacy mechanism, but within the pattern only [ 27 ] reports a directly measured privacy outcome; the other results coded under the privacy, safety, and trust family concern safety or trust rather than leakage or disclosure. The corpus-wide picture is the same: the only further study with a measured privacy outcome is [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 纯本地执行与本地执行器控制。 有七项研究将推理和执行器控制保留在设备或本地边缘节点上 [ 1 , 3 , 11 , 15 , 18 , 27 , 42 ] 。 [ 11 ] 通过将设备端 SLM 与本体和知识图谱相结合，避免智能家居意图理解对云端的依赖。 [ 27 ] 将隐私中介保持在边缘，并在任何数据被共享之前应用隐私增强技术（PETs），例如模糊化和删减。 [ 18 ] 将本地分析工具封装在 LLM 智能体之后，部分原因是为了让小型制造商无需云合同即可使用该系统。 在这些系统中，本地节点负责解释数据并做出决策。 该模式存在一点需要注意。 这些研究将数据本地化视为隐私机制，但在该模式中仅 [ 27 ] 报告了直接测量的隐私结果；其他归入隐私、安全和信任类别的结果关注的是安全性或信任，而非泄露或披露。 全语料库的整体情况相同：唯一另一项具有测量的隐私结果的研究是 [ 31 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Edge-first with selective cloud escalation. [ 23 ] escalates at the request level. It predicts time criticality and task complexity and chooses an LLM accordingly. [ 41 ] makes a related decision between reusing an edge vector cache and calling the cloud. [ 26 ] and [ 30 ] escalate at the subtask level rather than for whole requests. [ 31 ] escalates only after protected health information has been transformed locally. [ 39 ] moves from tiny edge models to large cloud models when a scene requires more accurate reasoning, and [ 8 ] moves from edge observation to cloud reasoning and external knowledge retrieval. [ 20 ] escalates to specialized tools instead of a larger cloud model, which changes the cost structure without relying on model scale. The recurring triggers are task complexity, model confidence, sensitivity of the raw data, and latency criticality.
paragraphs.zh: 边缘优先，选择性向云端升级。 [ 23 ] 在请求级别进行升级。 它预测时间紧迫性和任务复杂度，并据此选择相应的大语言模型。 [ 41 ] 在复用边缘向量缓存与调用云端之间做出相关决策。 [ 26 ] 和 [ 30 ] 在子任务级别而非整个请求级别进行升级。 [ 31 ] 仅在受保护的医疗健康信息已在本地完成转换之后才进行升级。 [ 39 ] 在场景需要更精确推理时从微型边缘模型切换到大型云端模型，而 [ 8 ] 则从边缘观察转向云端推理和外部知识检索。 [ 20 ] 升级到专用工具而非更大的云端模型，从而在不依赖模型规模的情况下改变了成本结构。 反复出现的升级触发因素包括任务复杂度、模型置信度、原始数据的敏感性以及时延紧迫性。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical edge/MEC/cloud orchestration. Sixteen studies place roles and subtasks across tiers with schedulers or orchestrators. In [ 2 ] , the planner decomposes intents and delegates across OSS domains. In [ 10 ] , role-affinity scheduling distributes roles across hierarchical edge resources. In [ 6 ] , a local tool-augmented LLM turns sustainability goals into MEC traffic-steering actions. In [ 16 ] , predicted service intents feed forward into service-function-chain deployment at the edge. In [ 32 ] , request routing and GPU autoscaling are optimized together over several timescales with traffic forecasting and integer linear programming, which shows that the cloud tier itself is adaptive rather than a static endpoint [ 35 ] . [ 37 ] improves the transport of task-related information between agents, so performance gains do not have to come from model placement alone. The pattern also appears outside network management. [ 13 ] coordinates perception, preprocessing, analytics, and optimization layers through an LLM planner in smart manufacturing. [ 19 ] layers electric-vehicle functions so that edge computing supports low-latency inference by task-specific agents. [ 21 ] triggers repair agents over enterprise reporting workflows from a mobile-cloud orchestration layer. [ 29 ] separates global coordination from regional LLM agents for online pathfinding, and [ 40 ] formulates a cloud-edge-device framework for vehicular task offloading.
paragraphs.zh: 分层的边缘/MEC/云编排。 十六项研究通过调度器或编排器将角色和子任务分布到各层级。 在[ 2 ]中，规划器分解意图并在OSS域之间进行委派。 在[ 10 ]中，角色亲和性调度将角色分布到分层的边缘资源上。 在[ 6 ]中，本地工具增强型LLM将可持续性目标转化为MEC流量引导动作。 在[ 16 ]中，预测的服务意图前馈到边缘的服务功能链部署中。 在[ 32 ]中，通过流量预测和整数线性规划，在多个时间尺度上联合优化请求路由和GPU自动伸缩，这表明云层级本身是自适应的，而不是静态端点[ 35 ]。 [ 37 ]改进了智能体之间任务相关信息的传输，因此性能提升不必仅来自模型部署。 该模式也出现在网络管理之外的领域。 在智能制造中，[ 13 ]通过LLM规划器协调感知、预处理、分析和优化各层。 [ 19 ]对电动汽车功能进行分层，使边缘计算能够由任务专用智能体支持低延迟推理。 [ 21 ]通过移动-云编排层在企业报表工作流上触发修复智能体。 [ 29 ]将全局协调与用于在线寻路的区域LLM智能体分离，[ 40 ]则为车辆任务卸载构建了云-边-端框架。

paragraphs.en: Federated and collaborative adaptation. Three studies show variants of edge-side adaptation: federated LLM reporting in a roadside inspection pipeline [ 14 ] , federated LLM-agent workloads on a heterogeneous K3s cluster [ 17 ] , and collaborative fine-tuning of personal LLMs among nearby devices [ 33 ] . The fine-tuning method of [ 44 ] and the federated and edge learning design space of [ 45 ] supply the techniques that make these deployments practical.

paragraphs.en: State continuity, communication, and migration. Only three studies fall under this pattern, although mobile and industrial IoT depend on it. [ 22 ] shows that the communication protocols themselves can be insecure in ways that change agent behavior. [ 24 ] makes agents reachable through shadowing instead of assuming that every agent is openly addressable. [ 36 ] treats agent memory as a distributed systems problem and lets agents negotiate memory operations through an intent-indexed framework.

paragraphs.en: Governance-gated closed loops. Seven studies build governance into the deployment itself [ 9 , 27 , 28 , 31 , 38 , 42 , 43 ] . [ 28 ] converts high-level intent into fine-grained access-control policies and enforces them through proxies. [ 9 ] conditions the outsourcing of agent tasks on cost-benefit analysis, skill verification, reputation, and security-risk assessment. [ 38 ] checks policy, risk, capability, and a digital twin before a manufacturing action is executed. The fusion controller of [ 43 ] has a similar effect: it decides whether the expected gain justifies spending bandwidth and latency on richer sensor fusion. This pattern matters most in regulated or high-risk IoT environments, which require a check of whether the system may act before it does.
paragraphs.zh: 治理门控的闭环。 七项研究将治理构建到部署本身之中 [ 9 , 27 , 28 , 31 , 38 , 42 , 43 ] 。 [ 28 ] 将高层意图转换为细粒度的访问控制策略，并通过代理加以强制执行。 [ 9 ] 将智能体任务的外包建立在成本效益分析、技能验证、信誉和安全风险评估之上。 [ 38 ] 在执行制造操作之前检查策略、风险、能力和数字孪生。 [ 43 ] 的融合控制器具有类似的效果：它决定预期的收益是否值得为更丰富的传感器融合付出带宽和延迟的代价。 这种模式在受监管或高风险的物联网环境中最为重要，这些环境要求在系统行动之前先检查其是否可以行动。

paragraphs.en: Three weaknesses in the deployment literature are not visible from the taxonomy alone. First, every study implements its escalation trigger differently. [ 23 ] learns a time-criticality predictor, [ 26 ] decomposes dependency graphs, [ 30 ] uses modality- and dialogue-aware policies, and [ 41 ] uses cache-similarity thresholds. No study compares its trigger with another study’s trigger, so it is unknown which escalation signal is most reliable. What is known is only that escalation beats purely local and purely cloud baselines within each study. Second, the local-only pattern is justified by privacy but rarely measured on privacy. Keeping data local is treated as protection in itself, which leaves leakage at inference time unexamined. Third, the state-continuity pattern rests on three studies, and none of them evaluates continuity under the conditions that motivate it, such as vehicular handover, intermittent uplinks, or NAT rebinding. The mechanisms that mobile and industrial IoT need most are currently the least tested.
paragraphs.zh: 仅从分类学本身无法看出部署文献中的三个弱点。 首先，每项研究对其升级触发的实现方式都不同。 [ 23 ] 学习了时间关键性预测器，[ 26 ] 对依赖图进行分解，[ 30 ] 使用了模态与对话感知的策略，[ 41 ] 则使用缓存相似度阈值。 没有任何研究将自己的触发机制与其他研究的触发机制进行比较，因此无法得知哪种升级信号最为可靠。 目前仅有的已知结论是，在各研究内部，升级优于纯本地与纯云的基线。 其次，仅本地模式以隐私为由进行论证，却很少在隐私方面进行实际测量。 将数据保留在本地本身被视为一种保护，这使得推理阶段的泄露问题未被考察。 第三，状态连续性模式依赖于三项研究，而这些研究均未在促使其产生动机的条件下评估连续性，例如车载切换、间歇性上行链路或 NAT 重绑定。 移动与工业物联网最需要的机制，恰恰是目前测试最少的机制。

paragraphs.en: Corpus profile. Before looking at what is measured, we summarize how the studies measure. Table 5 gives the profile of the 45 primary studies. The corpus is young. One study appeared in 2023 (the snowballed method paper [ 44 ] ), one in 2024, thirty-one in 2025, and twelve in 2026, and journals and conferences are almost evenly represented (23 versus 22). The share of real deployments is substantial. Twenty-nine of the 45 studies (64%) evaluate on physical devices, prototypes, or hardware testbeds, and two use production data [ 21 , 32 ] . Twelve studies rely on simulation or dataset experiments only, and two are conceptual [ 7 , 45 ] . Most studies compare against at least one baseline (42 of 45, 93%), but only 15 report ablation experiments that isolate their own components. In most systems it therefore remains unclear how much the router, the planner, or the governance gate contributes on its own. Reproducibility is the weakest point. We found public code or data for six studies [ 17 , 25 , 26 , 32 , 35 , 44 ] , one of them the snowballed method paper, or 13% of the corpus, which is low for a systems-oriented literature and makes the comparison problem of Section 7 worse. Finally, 24 of the 45 studies (53%) address IoT, industrial, smart-home, healthcare, vehicular, or robotics applications. Nineteen of these are evaluated on physical IoT or edge hardware or on production data, and five are IoT-motivated but evaluated in simulation [ 13 , 18 , 29 , 39 , 40 ] . The remaining 21 studies contribute methods, security analyses, or infrastructure that are not tied to one application domain. In the rest of this paper, claims about cyber-physical deployment rest on the studies with physical IoT evaluations, and we state it where a conclusion rests on simulation alone.

paragraphs.en: The primary studies name their models and hardware. On the device and edge tiers, open models below 8B parameters dominate. Qwen, Llama, Phi, Gemma, and Mistral variants between 0.5B and 8B carry most of the local reasoning, with 7B and 8B the most common sizes, and several systems distill or fine-tune these models for their role [ 5 , 15 , 33 ] . On the cloud tier, GPT-4-class commercial models are the most frequent choice for heavy reasoning and appear in the evaluations of roughly half the corpus, followed by Gemini- and Claude-class models; open models above 70B appear in a few systems, such as the 72B teacher model of [ 5 ] . The papers name hardware just as often. Jetson boards appear in at least eight studies, smartphones in seven, Kubernetes or K3s edge clusters in six, Raspberry Pi devices in five, and datacenter GPUs in thirteen; a study counts toward several platforms when it uses several. These counts come from the experimental-setup sections of the papers. The pairing of small local models with large cloud models from Section 4 is visible directly in this hardware split.

paragraphs.en: Table 7 groups the measured outcomes into five families. It also matters which outcome families are reported together. Latency and efficiency usually appear together, because both come out of the same offloading or scheduling experiment. Task success is often reported without the latency, cost, privacy, or resilience context needed for comparison, although 28 studies report more than one outcome family, for example success together with latency or with cost. Privacy and governance results rarely come with standard latency or cost numbers, so it is hard to tell whether a privacy-preserving design pays for itself. State continuity is the most isolated family; few studies report memory, migration, reachability, cache reuse, or robustness outcomes. This reporting pattern, more than any single result, is why papers in this area are hard to compare.

paragraphs.en: The reported numbers show real gains, each measured against its own baseline. Efficiency-oriented studies report latency reductions in the tens of percent [ 4 , 17 , 25 , 32 ] . The federated deployments quantify their savings against study-specific baselines: [ 17 ] reports 75% less network bandwidth, 45% lower end-to-end latency, and 61% less energy per inference than a naive deployment, and [ 14 ] reports 84% less communication overhead than full model synchronization. At cloud scale, [ 32 ] reports up to 25% GPU-hour savings and an 80% reduction in auto-scaling waste against a production baseline, or about $2.5M per month. Task-quality results cluster between 80% and 95% across recognition, retrieval, smart-home reasoning, and industrial scenarios [ 3 , 8 , 11 , 15 ] , with larger relative gains when domain knowledge is moved into tools [ 20 ] or when corner cases are evaluated separately [ 43 ] . These numbers cannot be compared across papers. Baselines, hardware, and workloads differ, and few papers report enough of the joint efficiency, quality, and privacy profile for a reader to reconstruct the trade-off.

paragraphs.en: The privacy, safety, and governance results are fewer but methodologically clear. [ 12 ] evaluates safety in realistic 5G scenarios and reports zero outages under high load, against 8.4% for fixed-power baselines and 3.3% for a competing agent baseline. [ 28 ] reports fully accurate policy generation in its transient-IoT configuration tasks. [ 31 ] separates PHI anonymization from cloud reasoning, so the privacy guarantee depends on the deployment rather than on the model. paragraphs.en: The open problems that emerge from the mapping concern the research practice of the field as much as its algorithms. The first open problem is benchmark fragmentation . Many individual papers are evaluated carefully, but almost every study builds its own evaluation environment. Five studies benchmark offloading, each in its own way [ 4 , 16 , 29 , 39 , 40 ] . [ 4 ] and [ 40 ] , for example, both study offloading in edge or vehicular settings, and both report gains in delay and efficiency, but they use different environments, optimization goals, baselines, and outcome sets, so their results cannot be ranked against each other. The same holds for local and hybrid assistance [ 1 , 3 , 8 , 11 , 31 ] and for industrial settings [ 13 , 15 , 18 , 38 ] . The studies make progress individually, but later work cannot build on earlier numbers. A benchmark for this area would have to combine agent tasks with continuum variables such as bandwidth, round-trip time, memory synchronization policy, and local privacy transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 这种映射所引发的开放性问题，既关乎该领域的算法，也同等地关乎该领域的研究实践。 第一个开放性问题是基准测试的碎片化。 许多单篇论文都经过了仔细评估，但几乎每项研究都构建了自己的评估环境。 有五项研究对卸载进行了基准测试，且各自采用的方式均不相同 [ 4 , 16 , 29 , 39 , 40 ] 。 例如，[ 4 ] 和 [ 40 ] 都研究了边缘或车载环境下的卸载，且都报告了在延迟和效率方面的收益，但它们使用了不同的环境、优化目标、基线和结果集合，因此它们的结果无法相互比较排名。 本地与混合辅助领域 [ 1 , 3 , 8 , 11 , 31 ] 以及工业环境领域 [ 13 , 15 , 18 , 38 ] 的情况也是如此。 这些研究各自单独取得了进展，但后续工作无法建立在早期研究的数值之上。 这一领域的基准测试必须将智能体任务与连续体变量相结合，例如带宽、往返时延、内存同步策略以及本地隐私变换。

paragraphs.en: The third open problem is protocol and tool security . [ 22 ] is the only systematic security analysis of agent communication protocols in the corpus. [ 24 ] and [ 37 ] improve reachability and communication efficiency, and [ 27 ] and [ 28 ] add governance layers, but adversarial evaluation is rare. At the same time, MCP [ 25 ] and A2A [ 26 ] are being adopted quickly, security analyses of this protocol layer already list authentication, authorization, and context-poisoning weaknesses [ 27 ] , and application-security guidance counts excessive agency and insecure tool use among the main LLM risks [ 29 ] . Edge-resident teams are absent from this line of work, although privacy is one of their main motivations (see Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第三个开放问题是协议与工具安全。 [ 22 ] 是语料库中唯一对智能体通信协议进行系统性安全分析的工作。 [ 24 ] 和 [ 37 ] 改进了可达性与通信效率，[ 27 ] 和 [ 28 ] 增加了治理层，但对抗性评估却很少见。 与此同时，MCP [ 25 ] 和 A2A [ 26 ] 正被快速采用，针对这一协议层的安全分析已经列出了身份验证、授权和上下文投毒等弱点 [ 27 ] ，且应用安全指南将过度自主性和不安全的工具使用列为大语言模型的主要风险 [ 29 ] 。 尽管隐私保护是边缘端智能体团队的主要动机之一（见图 3 ），但这一研究路线中并未涉及边缘端团队。

paragraphs.en: The fourth open problem is federated lifecycle management . paragraphs.en: Figure 4 summarizes what a benchmark for this area would have to control: a task profile, a continuum profile, a state profile, a governance and security profile, and a fixed set of reported outcomes. paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The main threat is the search strategy. The search string selects studies that call their systems LLM agents, LLM-based agents, or agentic AI, so relevant work under other labels, such as distributed LLM systems, federated LLMs, collaborative inference, or model placement, may be underrepresented. We reduced this risk in three ways. The search ran on full text in four databases, not only on titles and abstracts. Backward and forward snowballing was applied from the included studies. And we checked directly that three well-known systems from the adjacent terminology (EdgeShard, Galaxy, PerLLM) are reachable from the corpus by snowballing, as described in Section 3 ; they are excluded by our criteria because they optimize a single model, not because the search missed their vocabulary. The string also omits the bare terms multi-agent and IoT, so coverage of such work depends on the papers using one of the agent terms somewhere in their full text. The remaining risk concerns multi-component systems that are described without any agent vocabulary. We cannot rule such cases out, and the corpus should not be read as complete in that direction.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 主要威胁是检索策略。 检索字符串所筛选的研究须将其系统称为 LLM agents、基于 LLM 的 agents 或 agentic AI，因此以其他标签命名的相关工作，如分布式 LLM 系统、联邦 LLM、协作推理或模型部署，可能被低估。 我们通过三种方式降低了这一风险。 检索在四个数据库中基于全文进行，而不仅限于标题和摘要。 对纳入的研究应用了向后和向前滚雪球法。 并且我们直接验证了相邻术语中的三个知名系统（EdgeShard、Galaxy、PerLLM）可以通过滚雪球法从语料库中获取，如第 3 节所述；它们因我们的排除标准而被排除，原因是它们优化的是单一模型，而不是因为检索遗漏了它们的术语。 该检索字符串还遗漏了单独的术语 multi-agent 和 IoT，因此对这类工作的覆盖取决于论文在全文某处使用了某个 agent 术语。 剩余的风险涉及那些在描述时未使用任何 agent 词汇的多组件系统。 我们无法排除此类情况，因此不应将语料库视为在这一方向上是完备的。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Selection, extraction, and classification involve judgment. Several studies show traits of more than one architectural family or deployment pattern. We reduced the risk of bias with a predefined protocol, one shared extraction form, a pilot round on borderline cases, checking of every architecture assignment by a second author, and an external expert review of the search, extraction, and analysis steps. The record of how each study was evaluated relies on what the papers state, and borderline judgments, for example between a hardware testbed and a realistic emulation, remain possible. We did not compute an inter-rater agreement statistic; the complete coding is published, so others can re-code the corpus and measure agreement against it. Some subjectivity cannot be removed when heterogeneous systems are mapped into shared categories.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 选择、提取和分类都涉及主观判断。 多项研究同时表现出不止一种架构家族或部署模式的特征。 我们通过预先定义的规程、一份共享的提取表、针对边界案例的试提取轮次、由第二作者核查每一项架构归类，以及对检索、提取和分析步骤进行外部专家评审，来降低偏倚风险。 对每项研究如何被评估的记录依赖于论文本身的陈述，而边界判断——例如在硬件测试床与逼真仿真之间——仍然可能出现。 我们没有计算评分者间一致性统计量；完整的编码结果已公开发表，因此他人可以对语料库重新编码，并据此测量一致性。 当异构系统被映射到共享类别中时，某些主观性无法被消除。

sents.zh: 我们通过预先定义的规程、一份共享的提取表、针对边界案例的试提取轮次、由第二作者核查每一项架构归类，以及对检索、提取和分析步骤进行外部专家评审，来降低偏倚风险。

sents.en: The record of how each study was evaluated relies on what the papers state, and borderline judgments, for example between a hardware testbed and a realistic emulation, remain possible.
sents.zh: 对每项研究如何被评估的记录依赖于论文本身的陈述，而边界判断——例如在硬件测试床与逼真仿真之间——仍然可能出现。

sents.en: We did not compute an inter-rater agreement statistic; the complete coding is published, so others can re-code the corpus and measure agreement against it.
sents.zh: 我们没有计算评分者间一致性统计量；完整的编码结果已公开发表，因此他人可以对语料库重新编码，并据此测量一致性。

sents.en: Some subjectivity cannot be removed when heterogeneous systems are mapped into shared categories.
sents.zh: 当异构系统被映射到共享类别中时，某些主观性无法被消除。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. The taxonomy is one reasonable structure for these 45 studies, not the only one. Other researchers could emphasize other dimensions or classify borderline studies differently. The reported evaluations differ in workloads, datasets, hardware, network conditions, and metrics, so we do not compare performance across studies and we make no claims that one architecture outperforms another. Our conclusions are statements about frequencies, combinations, and gaps. Each family and pattern rests on at least three primary studies. Removing the two records added by snowballing changes no category and no reported trend, and the corpus-level counts they enter (publication years, artifact count, size of the federated family) are marked where they are reported.
paragraphs.zh: 结论效度。该分类法是针对这 45 项研究的一种合理结构，而非唯一结构。其他研究者可能强调其他维度，或对边界性研究做出不同分类。所报告的评估在工作负载、数据集、硬件、网络条件和指标上各不相同，因此我们不跨研究比较性能，也不声称某种架构优于另一种。我们的结论是关于频率、组合和空白的陈述。每个家族与模式都至少基于三项一手研究。移除通过滚雪球法新增的两条记录不会改变任何类别或任何已报告的趋势，而这些记录所涉及的语料库层面统计（发表年份、工件数量、联邦家族的规模）在报告处均已标注。

paragraphs.en: External validity. Most primary studies appeared in 2025 and 2026, and 45 studies is a modest base for a fast-moving field. The families, patterns, and gaps reported here describe the literature up to March 2026 and should be read as a snapshot, not as a lasting characterization. Since 24 of the 45 studies are grounded in IoT, industrial, smart-home, healthcare, vehicular, robotics, or sensor-cloud settings, the findings may also not carry over to multi-agent LLM systems outside continuum settings.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 大多数原始研究发表于2025年和2026年，对于一个快速发展的领域而言，45项研究的基础规模较为有限。 本文报告的类别、模式与空白描述的是截至2026年3月的文献情况，应将其视为一个快照，而非持久性的概括。 由于45项研究中有24项以物联网、工业、智能家居、医疗健康、车联网、机器人或传感云环境为基础，这些发现可能也难以推广到连续体环境之外的多智能体LLM系统。

paragraphs.en: This paper reported a systematic mapping study of multi-agent LLM systems on the cloud-edge-IoT continuum. From 831 records retrieved up to March 2026, we selected 45 primary studies, classified each by architecture, deployment mechanism, application domain, and evaluation practice, and recorded how each study evaluates its system.
paragraphs.zh: 本文报告了一项关于云-边-物联网连续体上多智能体大语言模型系统的系统性映射研究。 从截至2026年3月检索到的831条记录中，我们筛选出45项原始研究，按照架构、部署机制、应用领域和评估实践对每项研究进行分类，并记录了每项研究如何评估其系统。

sents.en: This paper reported a systematic mapping study of multi-agent LLM systems on the cloud-edge-IoT continuum.
sents.zh: 本文报告了一项关于云-边-物联网连续体上多智能体大语言模型系统的系统性映射研究。

sents.en: From 831 records retrieved up to March 2026, we selected 45 primary studies, classified each by architecture, deployment mechanism, application domain, and evaluation practice, and recorded how each study evaluates its system.
sents.zh: 从截至2026年3月检索到的831条记录中，我们筛选出45项原始研究，按照架构、部署机制、应用领域和评估实践对每项研究进行分类，并记录了每项研究如何评估其系统。

paragraphs.en: The mapped studies repeat a small set of designs. Five architectural families recur, from specialized agent teams at the edge to the infrastructure that carries them, and deployment relies on six recurring mechanisms, from local-only execution to governance-gated control. More than half of the studies are set in IoT, industrial, healthcare, smart-home, vehicular, or robotics applications, and 29 of the 45 are evaluated on physical hardware, mostly with open models below 8B parameters on the device and edge tiers. These findings describe the literature up to March 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 被梳理的研究重复使用了一小组设计。 五类架构族系反复出现，从边缘的专用智能体团队到承载它们的基础设施，而部署则依赖六种反复出现的机制，从纯本地执行到受治理门控的控制。 超过一半的研究设定在物联网、工业、医疗、智能家居、车联网或机器人应用中，且 45 篇中有 29 篇在物理硬件上进行评估，其中大多是在设备层和边缘层使用低于 8B 参数的开源模型。 这些发现描述了截至 2026 年 3 月的文献情况。

paragraphs.en: The main obstacle the mapping exposes is comparability. Studies report gains in latency, task quality, efficiency, privacy, or resilience, but under different workloads, hardware, network conditions, and metrics, and only six studies release artifacts. Privacy in particular motivates many designs but is directly measured in only two studies. Until studies report their deployment conditions in a shared form, new results will remain difficult to compare with old ones. The reporting checklist in Section 7 is a step that individual authors can take now, without waiting for a common benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 这一映射所揭示的主要障碍是可比性。 各研究分别在时延、任务质量、效率、隐私或韧性方面报告了收益，但所用的工作负载、硬件、网络条件和指标各不相同，而且只有六项研究公开了工件。 尤其是隐私，它推动了许多设计，但只有两项研究对其进行了直接测量。 在各研究以共享的形式报告其部署条件之前，新结果仍将难以与旧结果进行比较。 第 7 节中的报告清单是各位作者现在就可以采取的一项措施，无需等待通用基准的出现。

paragraphs.en: For IoT researchers and practitioners, the practical questions are how to divide responsibilities among devices, edge resources, and cloud services, and which governance mechanisms should regulate the result. The taxonomy, the study-level records, and the guidance in this paper are intended as a starting point for those decisions, and the archived protocol and data allow both to be checked and extended.
paragraphs.zh: 对于物联网研究人员和从业者来说，实际问题是如何在设备、边缘资源和云服务之间划分职责，以及应该由哪些治理机制来规范其结果。 本文的分类法、研究层面的记录以及相关指南旨在作为这些决策的起点，而存档的协议和数据使得两者都可以得到检验和扩展。
